channel.title: Blindspot
channel.description: Independent, rigorous analysis of geopolitics, global economy, security, technology, and power. What mainstream coverage leaves out.

item.title: Syria denies troop deployments to Yemen as military channels with Saudi Arabia open
item.description: Damascus has rejected reports of active military support for Saudi anti-Houthi efforts. Yet the diplomatic signaling points toward an expanding security dialogue between two former regional adversaries.

item.title: The Structural Realities Behind the 2026 U.S. Senate Midterm Map
item.description: As the 2026 U.S. Senate elections approach, thirty-five seats are up for grabs across an unforgiving electoral map. Controlling the chamber requires navigating tight margins, special elections, and structural legislative hurdles.

item.title: US Export Controls Fail as Nvidia AI Chips Reach Empty Chinese Shell Firms
item.description: Federal regulators have cleared advanced Nvidia processors for distribution to Chinese entities with empty offices and blacklisted backers. The lapse highlights the structural conflicts of a revenue-sharing export model.

item.title: Inside the House GOP revolt as Stephen Miller takes the West Wing helm
item.description: President Donald Trump's decision to appoint Stephen Miller as chief of staff has triggered open rebellion among congressional Republicans. The move deepens internal party fractures following historic midterm losses.

item.title: How the wider Iran war shattered Yemen's fragile truce and reignited a dormant conflict
item.description: Fresh airstrikes reported near Sanaa have left dozens dead, exposing how regional escalation with Iran immediately broke Yemen's fragile ceasefire. The United Nations reports that more than 1,600 people have been killed since major hostilities resumed.

item.title: An armed attack in Krakow exposes the security vulnerabilities of open European public squares
item.description: Five people are dead and at least 10 injured following a shooting near the main market square in Krakow. The incident highlights the persistent difficulty of securing dense urban environments against sudden localized violence.

item.title: Guatemalan Lawmaker Murder Highlights Rising Political Risk Ahead of National Elections
item.description: An armed ambush in eastern Guatemala leaves a member of congress and three officers dead. The attack underscores the lethal overlap between organized crime corridors and national political party realignment.
